home.eyebrow: Onboarding platform for companies · B2B UX/UI design case
home.title: Everyone knows what to do, with whom and by when
home.intro: Rumbo is a platform where HR designs the onboarding journey for each role, managers support it with check-ins and new hires always know what comes next. HR tracks progress and spots where journeys get stuck.
home.demoBody: It is a clickable prototype with fictitious data from Nortia S.A., a made-up technology services company. Your changes are only saved in this browser.

problem.title: Without a clear journey, the first month is lost in questions
problem.subtitle: When onboarding depends on scattered emails and spreadsheets, each team moves on its own and nobody sees the whole picture.

items.title: The new hire does not know what is due today
items.body: The new hire does not know what to do, with whom or by when, and asks everything over chat.

items.title: Tasks get stuck between teams
items.body: One missing access holds back the rest of the journey, and nobody knows who to ask.

items.title: HR finds out too late
items.body: Without progress data, delays do not show up until the 90 day meeting.

solution.title: The whole onboarding journey in one place
solution.subtitle: HR designs it, the direct manager supports and the new hire always knows what comes next.

items.title: Journeys by stage
items.body: Preboarding, Week 1, Month 1 and Days 30 to 90, with tasks that unlock as others are completed.

items.title: Template builder
items.body: HR builds the journey for each role with drag and drop and deadlines relative to the start date.

items.title: 30, 60 and 90 day check-ins
items.body: The direct manager reviews milestones; if one is not met, they reschedule or escalate to HR.

items.title: Tracking dashboard
items.body: HR sees each hire's progress, overdue tasks by owner and where journeys get stuck.

items.title: Security and access
items.body: SSO sign-in, two-step verification, role-based permissions and audit log, simulated.

stats.title: A navigable prototype with consistent simulated data
stats.subtitle: The figures are calculated from the Nortia S.A. demo data.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What to know before exploring the demo.

designSystem.title: Design system

nav.label: Design system sections
nav.sheetDescription: Choose a section to go to it.

hero.title: A language to work for hours without tiring your eyes
hero.intro: Rumbo is a work tool for companies: dense with information, clear in hierarchy and accessible by design. This site gathers its foundations, components and patterns, built with the same tokens and components the product uses.

principles.title: Four decisions that guide everything else
principles.intro: When a screen is in doubt, it goes back to these principles.

tokens.title: From a raw value to a screen, in four tiers
tokens.intro: Tokens follow the tiers of Material 3 and the W3C Design Tokens Community Group. Each tier only uses the previous one: no component uses a loose value.

color.title: Color roles, not loose colors
color.intro: Each color has a Material 3 role and its "on" color for the text or icon on top. Values and contrast are read live from the tokens.

type.title: Inter with the Material 3 scale
type.intro: No text uses a loose size: always a role. Titles use the emphasized variant of M3 Expressive so hierarchy reads well with Inter.

space.title: An 8 px rhythm and tonal depth
space.intro: Hierarchy comes from surface levels, not shadows. Shadows are only for what floats.

icons.title: Material Symbols, one style
icons.intro: Rounded, weight 300, imported as SVG per icon. Outline by default and filled only for active or selected items.

motion.title: Purposeful motion, never decorative
motion.intro: Material 3 curves, between 150 and 300 ms. With "reduce motion" only opacity changes.

components.title: Real pieces of the product
components.intro: Everything you see here is the component Rumbo uses, not a picture.

patterns.title: Solutions that repeat across the product
patterns.intro: Each pattern comes from a recorded decision. The number points to docs/decisions.md.

a11y.title: WCAG 2.2 AA by design
a11y.intro: Not a review at the end: it lives in the tokens, the components and the automated tests.

voice.title: Professional, clear and warm
voice.intro: Neutral Latin American Spanish with informal "tú" across the product, and US English.

app.title: How the app is put together
app.intro: The design system is one more layer of the architecture: screens use it and never decide on their own.

principles.title: Clarity over decoration
principles.body: Strong hierarchy, one idea per block and a single main button per region. Richness comes from data and composition.

principles.title: Tonal depth, not shadows
principles.body: White cards stand out from the gray page by surface and border. No gradients, no shadows at rest.

principles.title: Accessible by default
principles.body: AA contrast checked by tests, focus always visible, states with icon and text, and an alternative to every gesture.

principles.title: Tool density
principles.body: Built for long hours: dense information, an 8 px rhythm, tabular figures and nothing that distracts.

tiers.caption: Raw values only define semantic roles; Tailwind turns them into utilities and components combine them into variants. In green, the checks that verify and document the system.

ui.title: Presentation
items: G, A, J, N and S

layers.caption: Screens never decide on their own: they check the pure domain rules and the permission matrix. State loads from seed data, is saved in the browser and every sensitive action leaves an audit event.

color.peopleNote: They identify people and their roles; they never signal states.
color.chartsNote: In this order. All reach at least 3:1 on white; status colors are never used as a series.
color.rule: Color is never the only signal: every state also has an icon and text.

samples.body-medium: You completed 13 of 18 tasks. 5 to go.

type.note: Tabular figures in KPIs, tables and dates. At least 12 px for reading; 11 px only in badges.

space.rhythm: 8 px rhythm: 32 px between sections and 8 to 16 px inside each one.
space.shapeNote: One shape for the whole product: soft corners, never round buttons.

rules: 20 px in dense UI, 24 px in navigation
Filled only for active or selected
Decorative with aria-hidden; icon-only buttons with a name and tooltip

uses: Completed tasks: the check draws itself
Progress bars: fill when they appear
Dialogs, menus and toasts: short fade and scale
motion.reduced: With "reduce motion" or prefers-reduced-motion, only opacity changes.

components.buttonsNote: Only one filled per region. Sizes: XS 32 px (dense rows), S 40 px (default), M 56 px (main action of one-step screens on mobile).
components.disabledReason: Fill in the template name to publish
components.fieldsNote: Visible label on top, helper text below with format and example, and the error where the helper is.
components.emailHelp: Your work email, for example: first.last@nortia.demo
components.dateError: Enter a date in the DD/MM/YYYY format
components.chipsNote: Pills for states, always with icon and text; chips for context.
components.kpiNote: Icon and sparkline on top, label, number with its caption next to it and the change below.
components.headerNote: Person with photo, chips with icon, a single h1 and a line saying what the screen is for.
components.headerDesc: Review the stage milestones with Sofía.
components.listNote: The whole row is the link, no underline. Icon on the left, title and facts in the middle, status on the right.
components.footerNote: Actions sit at the bottom of the form card, with an optional note on the left.
components.footerNoteText: Only your direct manager and HR see it.

patterns: One segment per stage, the "Today" marker in plum and the conclusion on top: "On track" or "N overdue tasks".
The whole row is the link; in details, label and value on the same row.
Date, greeting with the name in primary and chips with the context that needs attention.
As many cards per row as fit; no row with a single card.
Each role has its color: a ring on the photo or initials on its container.
When a sentence names another section or control, the name is a chip that takes you there.
Buttons sit in a footer inside the form card, never loose.
Person, what is happening with its icon, and the detail that explains it.
IT confirms identity with data on record, never with the request data.
The same header on every detail screen.
a11y: Checked by tests for every token pair.
2 px primary ring, never hidden by the top bar or toasts.
Visible label, helper with example, no errors while you type.
Everything works with the keyboard; drag and drop has an alternative.
Title, text summary and a table for screen readers.
No horizontal scroll at 320 px and at 200 % zoom.

principles: Short sentences and action verbs: "Save template", not "OK".
"We could not verify the code. Check that it has 6 digits."
Warm in the journey, neutral in panels, serious in lockouts and privacy.

steps.title: What data we use
items: Your work data: name, email, job title, area and manager.
Your journey progress, check-ins and self-reviews.
Your identification data (DNI, CUIL and bank account), always shown hidden.

steps.title: What we use it for
items: Organizing your journey tasks and telling you what to do and by when.
So your manager and HR can support you and see if something gets stuck.
Never for purposes outside your onboarding journey or to share it outside Nortia.

steps.title: Who sees it
items: Your manager sees your journey and your self-reviews.
HR sees the company journeys. Identification data is only shown with a reason, which is recorded.
IT only sees what it needs to manage your access.

steps.title: How long and your rights
items: Journey data is kept {{journeyYears}} years after it ends; then it is anonymized.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your data from My privacy (Argentine Law 25,326).

accessTasks.purpose: Access to grant or revoke for joiners, movers and leavers.
points: Filter the pending ones.
Mark each access as you complete it.
The leaver already disabled the account; here you close its access.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.purpose: Sensitive changes waiting for a second person in IT.
points: Approve or reject with a note.
Nobody approves what they asked for or what affects them.
IT never keeps fewer than two people.

campaigns.title: Review campaigns
points: Create a campaign with scope and due date.
Follow the progress and remind whoever is missing.
Execute the revocations and close with the summary.

security.title: Security and audit
points: Unlock accounts and close sessions.
Filter and export the audit log.
Check the permissions matrix and propose policy changes.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.purpose: Notices about what happened and what you need to do.
points: Filter unread ones or by type.
Each notice takes you to the action.
See how it arrives by email.

search.title: Search
search.purpose: Find people, templates, tasks and requests.
points: Open search with Ctrl + K or /.
Filter results by type.
You only see what your role can open.

mySecurity.title: My security
mySecurity.purpose: How access to your account is protected.
points: Turn on or check two-step verification.
See your open sessions and close the ones you do not recognize.
Answer Was it you? after an unusual sign-in.

myPrivacy.title: My privacy
myPrivacy.purpose: The privacy notice and the data of yours Rumbo uses.
points: Check what data the platform has.
Request access, rectification or deletion.
Follow each request's deadline.

reports.title: Reports and exports
reports.description: Download Rumbo's data to analyze or present it. Sensitive data always goes out hidden.
reports.listHelp: They open in any spreadsheet app. DNI, CUIL and bank account go out hidden.

hires.title: Hires
hires.body: Each journey with its status, progress, overdue tasks, manager and template.

overdue.title: Overdue tasks
overdue.body: The overdue tasks of every journey, with their owner and days late.

checkins.title: Check-ins
checkins.body: The 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins with their due date, status and milestones met.

people.title: People
people.body: Work details, role and status of each person, with DNI, CUIL and bank account hidden.

unmasked.title: People with unhidden data
unmasked.description: For procedures that require it (for example, payroll). It needs another person in IT to approve it and it downloads only once.
unmasked.intro: IT reviews the request. If approved, you can download the list of people with DNI, CUIL and bank account once, and the download goes to the audit log.
unmasked.reasonHelp: Why you need the data unhidden. Between 10 and 300 characters. For example: Payroll accounts for November.
unmasked.reasonRequired: Write the reason, with at least 10 characters.
unmasked.reasonMax: The reason can have up to 300 characters.
unmasked.pending: Your request {{id}} is waiting for IT's approval. Meanwhile you cannot request another.
unmasked.approved: {{name}} approved your request {{id}}. You can download the list once.
unmasked.used: You already downloaded the list of request {{id}} on {{date}}. For another download, request a new approval.
unmasked.downloaded: List downloaded. It is recorded in the audit log.

print.title: Views to print or save as PDF
print.body: In <panel>Dashboard</panel> and in each hire's record, from <hires>Hires</hires>, the Print button opens the view to print or save as PDF, without the menu or the top bar.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How you want to see Rumbo and where to get notifications. They are saved for your account.

language.title: Language
language.label: Interface language
language.help: Changes every text in Rumbo. What people write is not translated.

dates.title: Date and time
dates.timezoneHelp: Times are shown in this zone. For example, 10:00 in Buenos Aires: {{example}}.
dates.formatHelp: How dates are written across the platform. Today looks like: {{example}}.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: For each kind of notification, choose where to get it. Email is simulated: nothing is sent.

help.tasks: Tasks due soon, overdue and unblocked.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.reduceMotionHelp: Screens change without movement, only with fades. It also turns on if your system asks for it.
accessibility.highContrastHelp: Darker secondary text and stronger borders across the platform.
